name: TRAPPIST-1h
tagline: Холодная внешняя кромка — последний мир системы, покрытый льдом.

facts.label: Зона
facts.value: Beyond the habitable zone — a frozen shell world

history: TRAPPIST-1h is the outer sentinel — Mars-size and cold, receiving less starlight than Mars does from our Sun. Its water is almost certainly locked as ice, though a hydrogen blanket or subsurface ocean remains conceivable. It was the last of the seven to be pinned down — its single transits had to be decoded through the resonance pattern its siblings kept. As the chain's outer link it carries the formation story: these worlds assembled farther out where volatiles were cheap, then slid inward together into the tight harmony seen today.
